description:
Return the amenities of one hotel, or the chain's global amenity catalogue when hotel_id is omitted.

    Call it without hotel_id to discover the valid amenity IDs to use in search_hotels.

    No availability, rates or booking: this tool only returns descriptive information.

amenity_id.description: Restrict to one amenity ID, uppercase (e.g. POOL, WIFI_INTERNET, PARKING, RESTAURANT, FITNESS). Unknown IDs raise an error listing the valid ones; with hotel_id, an empty list means the hotel does not have this amenity.
amenity_id.title: Amenity Id

hotel_id.description: Hotel ID from search_hotels. If omitted, returns the chain's full amenity catalogue.
hotel_id.title: Hotel Id

language.description: Language of the labels. Accepted values: fr, en, de, it, es. A text missing in the requested language is returned in French.
language.title: Language

name: get_amenities
title: Get amenities
